principles: A learning request must be traceable to an observed evidence gap or uncertainty.
Owner approval may activate a lesson but does not make the lesson true.
Requested lessons must be tested by replay or an independent check before any promotion.
Requested learning may add comparison context but must not automatically raise confidence.
Conflicting evidence remains visible; missing evidence means abstain.
No requested lesson can increase Sentinel enforcement authority.
No requested lesson may silently mutate guarded cognition regions.
